description: The evolvable harness of the hub-chat domain: everything RRSI may change about how the frozen policy engine is driven. Each field belongs to exactly one component of K.

instructions.description: General working instructions appended to the policy engine's system prompt.

output_contract.description: How the final answer must be shaped (structure, language, citation of tool evidence, length).

engine_config.description: Settings of the policy engine. Only keys the policy engine declares in its manifest are accepted; frozen keys are refused.

max_steps.description: Step budget of the policy engine for one turn (null = host default).

retry_on_failure.description: Run the policy turn once more when it errors or returns an empty answer (bounded: one retry).

history_turns.description: How many previous user/assistant exchanges the policy engine sees (null = all the host provides).

tool_ids.description: Allowlist of catalog tool ids exposed to the policy engine (empty = host's per-turn selection). Unknown ids are refused.

skills.description: Reusable, entity-free procedures injected into the policy prompt with the condition under which each applies.

memory.description: Entity-free working notes persisted across turns of this chat and injected into the policy prompt.

subagent_review.description: A bounded reviewer pass: a separate model call critiques the policy's draft answer once and returns a revised final answer.
